_prov.source: U.S. Census Bureau, ACS 2019–2023 5-year (tables B01001 age/sex, B03002 race/ethnicity), via Census API
_prov.method: District = state legislative district (lower chamber) 050. 'NYC' = the five counties summed. Shares from raw counts.
_prov.caveats: Survey estimates with margins of error (not shown). White/Black/Asian are alone, non-Hispanic; Hispanic is all races.
